description:
Jobs by workplace and employed residents by home location for every census block group in the City of St. Louis, from the U.S. Census Bureau's LEHD Origin-Destination Employment Statistics (LODES) version 8, data year 2023. LODES is the block-level jobs data behind the Bureau's OnTheMap tool; "Version 8 of LODES was enumerated by 2020 census blocks." Workplace Area Characteristics (jobs located in the block group, `jobs_*`) and Residence Area Characteristics (employed people living in the block group, `workers_resident*`) are aggregated here from census blocks to block groups — a block's block group is the first 12 characters of its 15-character geocode — with breakdowns by earnings band and selected NAICS sectors. LEHD notes that "the data released by LEHD are based on tabulated and modeled administrative data, which are subject to error"; these are administrative tabulations, not survey estimates, so no margins of error apply.

Unlike the city's own datasets in this catalog, this is **not** City of St. Louis data: it is federal administrative data published by the U.S. Census Bureau's Longitudinal Employer-Household Dynamics program, extracted for St. Louis city (FIPS 29510) and joined to the Bureau's 2024 cartographic boundary geometries. Pair it with `acs-block-groups` to compare daytime (working) and residential population, or with `lodes-commutes` for the underlying home→work flows.

table:columns.name: geoid
table:columns.description: 12-digit census block group GEOID. Join key to acs-block-groups and lodes-commutes.

table:columns.name: jobs_total
table:columns.description: All jobs located in the block group (LODES WAC column C000), aggregated from census blocks.

table:columns.name: jobs_earn_low
table:columns.description: Jobs with earnings of $1,250/month or less (LODES CE01).

table:columns.name: jobs_earn_mid
table:columns.description: Jobs with earnings of $1,251 to $3,333/month (LODES CE02).

table:columns.name: jobs_earn_high
table:columns.description: Jobs with earnings greater than $3,333/month (LODES CE03).

table:columns.name: jobs_manufacturing
table:columns.description: Jobs in Manufacturing, NAICS sectors 31-33 (LODES CNS05).

table:columns.name: jobs_retail
table:columns.description: Jobs in Retail Trade, NAICS sectors 44-45 (LODES CNS07).

table:columns.name: jobs_education
table:columns.description: Jobs in Educational Services, NAICS sector 61 (LODES CNS15).

table:columns.name: jobs_healthcare
table:columns.description: Jobs in Health Care and Social Assistance, NAICS sector 62 (LODES CNS16).

table:columns.name: jobs_food_accomm
table:columns.description: Jobs in Accommodation and Food Services, NAICS sector 72 (LODES CNS18).

table:columns.name: workers_resident
table:columns.description: Employed people living in the block group, wherever they work (LODES RAC column C000).

table:columns.name: workers_resident_earn_low
table:columns.description: Employed residents earning $1,250/month or less (LODES RAC CE01).

table:columns.name: workers_resident_earn_mid
table:columns.description: Employed residents earning $1,251 to $3,333/month (LODES RAC CE02).

table:columns.name: workers_resident_earn_high
table:columns.description: Employed residents earning more than $3,333/month (LODES RAC CE03).

styles/default.title: Jobs by workplace
styles/default.description: Where St. Louis works: total jobs located in each block group, light to dark blue. Downtown, the central corridor and the hospital campuses carry most of the city's employment.

styles/balance.title: Jobs vs. resident workers
styles/balance.description: Jobs located in the block group divided by employed residents living in it: purple block groups are bedroom areas, orange ones are job centers with few resident workers. Crime and service rates computed per residential population overstate risk in orange areas — their daytime population is far larger than their census count.
